settings.label: Hue Remote API client ID
settings.description: From your Remote Hue API app at developers.meethue.com, whose callback URL is http://127.0.0.1:51789/callback. Set it with the client secret to sign in to Philips Hue.

settings.label: Hue Remote API client secret
settings.description: The secret of the same Hue app. Argo keeps it in your computer’s secret store and sends it only to api.meethue.com.

operations.name: signIn
operations.label: Sign in to Philips Hue
operations.description: Opens Philips Hue's sign-in in the browser on the Server Device, with the Remote API app set in the Plugin's settings.

operations.name: cancelSignIn
operations.label: Cancel signing in to Philips Hue
operations.description: Stops waiting for the browser's Philips Hue sign-in.

operations.name: connectBridge
operations.label: Connect the Hue Bridge
operations.description: Presses the Hue Bridge's link button through Hue's cloud and keeps the application key it gives, so Argo can control the lights.

operations.name: setPower
operations.label: Switch a light or room
operations.description: Turns one Hue light, or every light in a room, on or off.

kind.description: light for one light, grouped_light for a room's lights.

id.description: The Hue id of the light or the room's grouped light.

operations.name: setBrightness
operations.label: Dim a light or room
operations.description: Sets the brightness of one Hue light, or of every light in a room, as a percentage.

kind.description: light for one light, grouped_light for a room's lights.

id.description: The Hue id of the light or the room's grouped light.

operations.name: listHousehold
operations.label: List the household's lights
operations.description: Lists the Hue rooms with their lights: each room's All lights level, and each light's power, brightness, colour (hue 0-359, saturation 0-100) and whether the Bridge can reach it, then the lights in no room.

operations.name: listScenes
operations.label: List a room's scenes
operations.description: Lists the scenes of one Hue room: each one's id, name, gradient colours as hex and whether it is the active scene. Optionally narrowed by a search of the name and paged.

roomId.description: The Hue id of the room, from listHousehold.

search.description: Only scenes whose name contains this text, ignoring case.

limit.description: The most scenes to answer, from 1 to 100. Default 25.

offset.description: How many scenes to skip, for the next page. Default 0.

operations.name: setColour
operations.label: Set a light's colour
operations.description: Sets the colour of one Hue light from a hue and a saturation, kept within the colours that light can show. A white-only or unreachable light is refused.

id.description: The Hue id of the light.

operations.name: recallScene
operations.label: Recall a room's scene
operations.description: Recalls a Hue scene so its room takes its lights and colours. The active scene shows once Hue confirms.

id.description: The Hue id of the scene, from listScenes.

capabilities.reason: Signs in to Philips Hue and controls the lights through Hue's Remote API, the host of the Account this Plugin provides.
